verdict.stance: Hold (IG Credit / Watch Jebel Ali & Leverage)
verdict.summary: Resilient global ports & logistics platform (77% non-UAE footprint): 1H26 revenue rose 13.1% to $12.7bn and Adj EBITDA dipped only 5.6% to $2.86bn (+9.7% ex-Jebel Ali) despite Jebel Ali throughput falling 59.5% (Q2 -90.1%) from regional conflict. Pre-IFRS 16 leverage ticked up to 3.7x (vs 4.0x policy cap). Priced EUR 750m 6Y green + USD 750m 10Y notes in Sep-26 25bp inside IPT.

positives: Global diversification buffer: 77% non-UAE portfolio grew EBITDA +9.7% in 1H26, absorbing the acute Jebel Ali disruption.
Strong market access & liquidity: $8.2bn liquidity at 1H26; repaid EUR 750m Sep-26 notes and priced EUR 750m (4.75%) + USD 750m (6.25% 2036) 25bp inside IPT.
Ratings affirmed: Moody's Baa2 Stable (25-Jun-26) and Fitch BBB+ Stable.
negatives: Narrowing leverage headroom: Pre-IFRS 16 net leverage rose to 3.7x (from 3.4x FY25) vs 4.0x internal policy ceiling.
Jebel Ali throughput shock (-59.5% 1H26, -90.1% Q2-26) alongside heavy ~$3.0bn annual capex commitment.
If Jebel Ali fails to normalize in 2027, ~$3.0bn capex could push leverage above 4.0x and trigger negative rating outlook.
